'''Upsilon group''' was a group of five [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports]] that served the [[Zaarin coup forces]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]]. It was destroyed during the [[Battle of Ottega]].
